summary: Plan v5 (faithful tree-recursive Hilbert bridge). This dispatch continued directly from the previous one's motive-design finding (nikTr-level motive needed, not sigAt-core, for efq/orE). Landed three further commits of cross-label infrastructure: sigAtFuel_mono_context (subset-based context monotonicity, holding uniformly at every label including siblings, superseding the earlier rank-threshold congruence in scope), sigAtFuel_mono_fuel/_le (unconditional fuel-gap monotonicity for sigAtFuel), and nikTrFuel_fuel_invariant_step (the genuine fuel-SUFFICIENCY equality lemma flagged since Phase 8.1: nikTrFuel is invariant once fuel exceeds the remaining ancestor-chain length, proved via induction on the graded-rank witness). All sorry-free, axiom-clean, scoped-build green, individually committed. Working through the natural 'propagate bottom up x's ancestor chain to the tree root, then back down to an arbitrary y' proof strategy for efq (avoiding an explicit LCA computation) surfaced a genuine, freshly-identified infrastructure GAP: this strategy needs every label reachable from a single distinguished root via Relation.ReflTransGen G.R, which is TRUE for every actual derivation graph (built from Graph.trivial + addEdge from existing nodes) but is NOT implied by IsDerivationForest's three existing conjuncts (finite + graded rank + unique parent) alone. This is not a machine-checked wall (no concrete efq/orE Lean goal has been attempted and refuted; every piece encountered across two dispatches has had a concrete, provable path, verified by compiling) but the cumulative remaining scope (root-connectivity invariant + preservation lemmas + propagate-up + propagate-down + orE's comparable treatment) is now estimated at 400-600+ further lines, several more dedicated dispatches -- well beyond Phase 8's own worst-case 6-run sizing for the WHOLE phase. Phase 8.2 stays [IN PROGRESS], not [BLOCKED].
decisions_made: sigAtFuel_mono_context (Delta contains Gamma pointwise implies Derivable(sigAtFuel Delta n z implies sigAtFuel Gamma n z), uniformly at every label) supersedes-in-scope the earlier rank-threshold sigAtFuel_congr_above_rank: the rank-threshold version could only relate labels of strictly greater rank than the extended label, insufficient for SIBLING branches (same rank), which the full ancestor-wrap's off-spine children require.

nikTrFuel's wrap step is asymmetric (implication/box, not conjunction), so unlike sigAtFuel it has NO unconditional fuel-monotonicity; the genuine fuel-sufficiency EQUALITY (nikTrFuel_fuel_invariant_step) was needed and built, via induction on an upper bound for the graded-rank witness ht.

Chose the 'propagate through a shared root' proof strategy for efq/orE (rather than an explicit lowest-common-ancestor computation), since G is always a single tree in practice -- but this exposed that IsDerivationForest as currently defined doesn't GUARANTEE single-tree connectivity (only local rank/uniqueness constraints), so a new root-connectivity invariant is needed before the strategy can be completed.
Did not attempt to define or prove the root-connectivity invariant in this dispatch -- flagged as the concrete next blocker for the next dispatch (or a dedicated /research pass) rather than rushed.
